endpoints.name: Create
endpoints.description: Creates a new partner organization with complete details including address, contact info, and organizational metadata.
example_uses: Create a new partner called UNICEF
Add a new organization with website www.redcross.org
Register a new government partner from Bangladesh
Set up a partner organization with contact details
Create a global key account partner
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to add, create, register, or set up a new partner.

endpoints.name: ListAllPartners
endpoints.description: Retrieves all partners with basic pagination and ordering (no search criteria).

ascending.description: Sort direction - true for ascending, false for descending (default: true)

example_uses: List all partners in the system
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to see ALL partners without any search criteria or when asking for a general partner list.

endpoints.name: SearchPartners
endpoints.description: Performs simple text search across multiple partner fields (name, description, etc.). This endpoint supports basic text search via the `searchText` parameter. For more complex, structured searches, use the `AdvancedSearchPartners` endpoint.

searchText.description: Text to search across partner name, description, and other basic fields

example_uses: Search for partners with 'Development' in description
Look for partners with specific keywords
Find partner by short name or acronym
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this for simple name, description, or basic field searches. NOT for complex criteria or relationship searches.

endpoints.name: AdvancedSearchPartners
endpoints.description: Performs advanced search with structured criteria including status, dates, relationships, and complex filters. Use the `searchCriteria` parameter as a JSON array of objects, where each object has `field`, `operator`, and `value`. Supported fields for search are: `id`, `name`, `status`, `partnerShortDescription`, `partnerLongDescription`, `partnerCategoryId`, `liaisonOfficeId`, `partnerFocalPointUserId`, `unAndStateEntity`, `keyGlobalPartner`, `unSecretariatPartner`, `dueDiligenceRequired`, `dueDiligenceApproval`, `dueDiligenceApprovalDate`, `dueDiligenceExpiryDate`, `partnerApprovalStatus`, `partnerApprovalDate`, `partnerApprovalReference`, `partnerApprovedBy`, `partnerLevyStatus`, `reasonForLevy`, `levyTreatment`, `pooledFund`, `canCreateNewOpportunities`, `reasonForNoNewOpportunity`, `createdDate`, `lastModifiedDate`, `createdBy`, `lastModifiedBy`, `isDeleted`, `shortName`, `description`, `phone`, `website`, `email`, `modifiedDate`. Date fields are: `createdDate`, `modifiedDate`. Operators include: `like`, `is`, `not`, `contains`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`, `between`, `greaterThan`, `lessThan`, `greaterThanOrEqual`, `lessThanOrEqual`, `on`, `not on`, `this week`, `this month`, `this year`. Example criteria: `[{"field":"name","operator":"like","value":"Foundation"},{"field":"status","operator":"is","value":"Active"}]`.

searchCriteria.description: JSON array of search criteria objects with field, operator, value, and logicalOperator

searchText.description: Optional additional text search to combine with criteria

example_uses: Show partners with global key account status
List partners with due diligence requirements
Search for partners by complex criteria combinations
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this for searches involving partner status, dates, approval status, or multiple field combinations.

endpoints.name: Get
endpoints.description: Retrieves a specific partner by ID with complete details including documents, contacts, and office information.
example_uses: Show me details for partner ID 123
Show partner with all related data
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks for specific partner details by ID or when you need complete partner information.

endpoints.name: Update
endpoints.description: Updates an existing partner's information including contact details, status, and organizational metadata.
example_uses: Update partner 123's name to New UNICEF
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to update, modify, edit, or change partner information.

endpoints.name: GetPartnerEngagements
endpoints.description: Retrieves all engagements for a specific partner with complete details and pagination.

partnerId.description: Partner ID to get engagements for

ascending.description: Sort direction - true for ascending, false for descending (default: true)

example_uses: Get engagement history for this partner
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to see all engagements associated with a specific partner from the partner's perspective.

endpoints.name: GetPartnerProjects
endpoints.description: Retrieves all projects associated with a specific partner with complete details and pagination.

partnerId.description: Partner ID to get projects for

ascending.description: Sort direction - true for ascending, false for descending (default: true)

example_uses: Get project history for this partner
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to see all projects associated with a specific partner.

endpoints.name: Delete
endpoints.description: Soft deletes a partner from the system (marks as deleted rather than permanent removal).
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to delete, remove, or eliminate a partner.

endpoints.name: ActivatePartner
endpoints.description: Activates a draft partner after validating mandatory fields

endpoints.name: ClosePartner
endpoints.description: Closes an active partner (only for NotApproved partners). Returns updated partner with closed status.
example_uses: Change status of partner 789 to closed
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when an active partner needs to be formally closed, typically for partners that are not yet approved.

endpoints.name: ArchivePartner
endpoints.description: Archives an active or closed partner (only for NotApproved partners). Returns updated partner with archived status.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when an active or closed partner needs to be moved to an archived status, typically for partners that are not yet approved.

endpoints.name: ApprovePartner
endpoints.description: Approves an active partner (Admin only) - locks data fields and records approval audit trail. Returns updated partner with approved status.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when an active partner needs to be formally approved by an administrator, which locks certain data fields and creates an audit trail.

endpoints.name: PermissionsGet
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current user's permissions for a specific partner (read, update, delete). Returns Permission object with CanRead, CanUpdate, CanDelete flags.
example_uses: What can I do with partner 456?
Get access rights for this partner
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when you need to check user permissions before performing operations or showing UI elements.

endpoints.name: UploadLogo
endpoints.description: Uploads and associates a logo image with a partner (max 1MB, JPEG/PNG/WEBP only). Returns success confirmation or error details.
example_uses: Add organization logo to partner record
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to add or update a partner's logo/image.

Available operators: `like`, `is`, `not`, `contains`, `startsWith`, `endsWith`, `between`, `greaterThan`, `lessThan`, `greaterThanOrEqual`, `lessThanOrEqual`, `on`, `not on`, `this week`, `this month`, `this year`. endpoints.name: ScanPartnerData
endpoints.description: Scans and processes uploaded files for partner data extraction using AI-powered analysis.

req.description: File scan request containing the file to be processed. The request object includes 'File' (IFormFile) and 'Type' (string). The 'File' property itself has a required 'Length' property.

example_uses: Scan partner contract document for data extraction
Upload partner registration form for processing
Analyze partner profile document with AI
Extract data from partner onboarding files
Process partner information from uploaded documents
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to upload and scan documents for partner data extraction using AI.

endpoints.name: AnalysePartnerData
endpoints.description: Analyzes uploaded files and extracts structured partner data using AI-powered data analysis.

request.description: Analysis request containing file and analysis parameters. The request object requires 'CurrentUserId' (integer) and 'IsUpdate' (boolean) properties.

example_uses: Analyze partner documents for structured data extraction
Extract partner information from uploaded forms
Process partner onboarding documents with AI
Convert partner files into structured database entries
Analyze partner contract data for key information
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to analyze files and extract structured partner data for database import.

endpoints.name: BulkUploadPartners
endpoints.description: Bulk uploads multiple partner records using AI-assisted data processing and validation.

req.description: Bulk upload request containing partner data. The request object requires an 'IsUpdate' (boolean) property and a 'Records' (array of objects) property.

example_uses: Bulk upload 100 partner organizations from Excel
Import multiple partners from CSV file
Mass upload partner data with AI validation
Bulk import partner records with duplicate detection
Upload large partner dataset with automated processing
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to upload multiple partner records at once with AI-assisted processing.

endpoints.name: GetMetadataInfo
endpoints.description: Describes the Partner entity structure including all field configurations.

endpoints.name: DeepSearch
endpoints.description: Performs semantic search on partners using AI embeddings to find relevant matches based on natural language queries. Returns multiple partners with similarity scores.

query.description: Natural language search query (e.g., 'partners working on climate change', 'organizations in Africa')

threshold.description: Similarity threshold for results (0.0 to 1.0, default: 0.7)

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

example_uses: Find partners working on climate change projects
Search for organizations in developing countries
Find partners with expertise in healthcare
Look for partners in the education sector
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to find partners using natural language descriptions, semantic concepts, or contextual search rather than exact text matching.
